correctness.rationale: CRT splitting into h+ and h− gives two disjoint p-point Fourier channels. Applying prime Chebotarev/Tao to both nonzero channels gives 2(p-k+1); one zero channel forces exactly k/2 antipodal pairs and yields p-k/2+1. Sharp cyclotomic polynomial construction has exactly s−1 roots and no zero coefficients by prime uncertainty. Algebra confirms crossover and p−7 gap. Exact verification script passes 75 sample support sizes.

originality.rationale: The claim is the exact-k first-half Fourier uncertainty profile for every odd prime, including nonmonotone jumps; the prior closest Bonami–Ghobber theorem addresses the at-most-k theta and its extremizers and cannot supply this exact profile when theta_exact rises. Loukaki provides parity-balanced minors and a stratified inequality, not the stated formula. Previous order-twelve computations and k=3/k=4 results are narrower.
